summary: Probably John's 1st cousin 5x removed; 'the leading merchant' at Hunlock Creek.
bio:
Son of widow Hulda; 21 in 1850. Became 'the leading merchant' at Hunlock Creek, with a store near the railroad station - the settlement where Frederick Croup had farmed.

FamilySearch tree KL4L-RDD calls him George Ransom Pringle, born April 1829 at Plymouth to Samuel D. Pringle and Hulda Ives. He married Mary C. Stookey (1842-1898), and their children were Ida A. (b. 1861) and Henry A. (b. Beach Haven 9 Jun 1864, d. 1940). He was in Plymouth Twp. in 1870 and died in Hunlock Twp. in April 1880 ([R4-S1]). The tree attaches an entry in the 1880 PA mortality schedule, which counts deaths in the census year ending 31 May 1880. That is a contemporary record of his death and fits Munsell's 'leading merchant' at Hunlock Creek.
sources: [R4-S1] FamilySearch published tree, George Ransom Pringle KL4L-RDD (derivative) https://www.familysearch.org/service/tree/tree-data/published/persons/KL4L-RDD
